entities.name: Malonyl-[ACP] O-methyltransferase
observations: Exact 275-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q609U9 (Methylococcus capsulatus); annotated EC 2.1.1.197.
Catalyzes SAM-dependent O-methylation of the free carboxyl group of malonyl-[ACP], producing malonyl-[ACP] methyl ester and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Associated with pimeloyl-ACP formation and biotin biosynthesis.

entities.name: Malonyl-ACP O-methylation
observations: malonyl-[ACP] + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → malonyl-[ACP] methyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine; Rhea RHEA:17105, enzyme EC 2.1.1.197.

entities.name: Biotin biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme annotation links malonyl-[ACP] methylation to pimeloyl-ACP synthesis in the biotin biosynthetic pathway.
